title: Ngaishing Industrial NS-95
subtitle: Pneumatic Collar Notcher (Shirt Final Finishing)

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The NS-95 is a pneumatic collar notcher from Ngai Shing — a finishing machine that produces knife and punch marks on shirt collars so the collar can be attached to the shirt body accurately. The notching distance is adjustable for different operations. Comes in V1.00 and V1.20 sub-versions; V1.20 is the currently-shipped variant.
applications: Standalone finishing or part of integrated shirt assembly line

overviewDescription: Made by Ngai Shing Development Ltd (Hong Kong, Cheung Sha Wan). Same parent brand as Ngai Shing NS-2410 (sleeve placket folder); the NS-95 is a different machine class (finishing machine for collar notching, not a sewing machine). Pneumatic control is the defining feature, with notching distance adjustable per application.
